title: New Gaps in Primes Visualization
full_prompt: Write a Manim script using the ManimGL framework that visualizes prime gaps on a large scale. First, construct a horizontal number line spanning from 99980 to 100100, shifted slightly left and up. Identify all prime numbers in this range using a library like sympy, and place glowing dots (or standard dots with a glow effect) at their corresponding positions on the number line. Add text labels for these prime numbers. Next, animate the camera (using self.frame) to pan and zoom in on a large prime near the center of the range. Label this prime as 'Big prime, p' in yellow with an arrow pointing to it. Then, create a brace spanning the gap between the last two primes in the range, labeled 'gap'. Finally, display the expected gap equation 'E[gap] = \ln(p)' at the top of the screen, using smooth FadeTransform transitions to morph the 'gap' and 'p' labels into their respective positions in the equation.

visual_techniques: Camera panning and zooming via self.frame

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using standard Manim Community Scene instead of InteractiveScene when self.frame is manipulated
common_failure_modes.note: In Manim Community, self.camera.frame must be used instead of self.frame, and the scene must inherit from MovingCameraScene.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing sympy import for prime calculation
common_failure_modes.note: The script relies on sympy.isprime to filter prime numbers in the specified range.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using GlowDots in standard Manim CE
common_failure_modes.note: GlowDots is a ManimGL-specific class. In Manim CE, standard Dots with a custom glow or multiple layered semi-transparent circles must be used.
TexText is specific to ManimGL. In Manim CE, Tex or MathTex should be used with appropriate LaTeX formatting.
